form.label: Postfix / Dovecot Mail Syslog Overview
form.description: Fixture-backed onboarding and first-triage view for Postfix delivery/reject/cleanup and Dovecot login/auth-failure/logout/session records. Dashboard presence is not replay/read-back validation.

search.query: index=$index$ ($sourcetype$) host="$host_filter$" earliest=$time_range.earliest$ latest=$time_range.latest$ | eval mail_actor=coalesce(user, recipient), mail_source=coalesce(src_ip, rip), mail_destination=coalesce(relay_host, relay_ip, lip, dest), mail_family=case(sourcetype="mail:postfix:delivery","Postfix delivery", sourcetype="mail:postfix:reject","Postfix reject", sourcetype="mail:postfix:cleanup","Postfix cleanup", sourcetype="mail:dovecot:login","Dovecot login", sourcetype="mail:dovecot:auth_failure","Dovecot auth failure", sourcetype="mail:dovecot:logout","Dovecot logout", sourcetype="mail:dovecot:session","Dovecot session", true(), sourcetype) | where "$user_filter$"="*" OR like(mail_actor, "$user_filter$")
| search sourcetype="mail:dovecot:login" action=login result=success | stats count
| search sourcetype="mail:dovecot:auth_failure" action=auth_failure result=failure | stats count

panel.title: Volume over time by mail family

search.query: | timechart span=15m count by mail_family limit=10 useother=f
| stats count by sourcetype mail_family | sort - count
| stats count values(sourcetype) as sourcetypes values(action) as actions values(result) as results by mail_actor | sort - count
| search mail_source=* | stats count values(sourcetype) as sourcetypes values(user) as users values(reason) as reasons values(session) as sessions by mail_source | sort - count
| search sourcetype="mail:postfix:delivery" | table _time host queue_id recipient relay_host relay_ip dest_port dsn delay delays vendor_raw_status result marker | sort - _time
| search sourcetype="mail:postfix:reject" | table _time host queue_id src_ip src_port vendor_raw_action result reason signature marker | sort - _time
| search sourcetype="mail:dovecot:login" | table _time host user auth_method rip lip src_ip dest_ip tls_state session action result marker | sort - _time
| search sourcetype="mail:dovecot:session" | table _time host user vendor_raw_action action uid message_id mailbox signature marker | sort - _time
| search sourcetype="mail:dovecot:auth_failure" | table _time host user auth_method rip lip src_ip dest_ip tls_state session failure_reason action result marker | sort - _time

| search sourcetype="mail:dovecot:logout" | table _time host user session logout_in_bytes logout_out_bytes deleted_count expunged_count trashed_count hdr_count hdr_bytes body_count body_bytes action result marker | sort - _time

| search queue_id=* OR message_id=* OR session=* | stats count earliest(_time) as first_seen latest(_time) as last_seen values(sourcetype) as sourcetypes values(action) as actions values(result) as results values(recipient) as recipients values(user) as users values(relay_host) as relays values(mailbox) as mailboxes values(failure_reason) as failure_reasons values(logout_in_bytes) as logout_in_bytes values(logout_out_bytes) as logout_out_bytes values(marker) as markers by queue_id message_id session | convert ctime(first_seen) ctime(last_seen) | sort - count

| stats count dc(sourcetype) as sourcetypes values(sourcetype) as sourcetype_values min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen by source host | convert ctime(first_seen) ctime(last_seen) | sort - count

| table _time index sourcetype source host vendor product program postfix_daemon dovecot_program action result queue_id message_id user recipient src_ip rip relay_host failure_reason logout_in_bytes logout_out_bytes expunged_count marker _raw | sort - _time

html.p: This dashboard intentionally uses only fields represented by the Postfix/Dovecot fixtures and Splunk props. It does not prove live mail-server replay/read-back validation, LMTP, policy-service logs, or broader mail-gateway coverage.
html.pre: index=email "SC4S_POSTFIX_DOVECOT_MAIL_TEST_" earliest=-2h | table _time index sourcetype source vendor product program postfix_daemon dovecot_program queue_id action result vendor_raw_status vendor_raw_action recipient relay_host relay_ip src src_ip src_port rip lip user auth_method session uid message_id mailbox failure_reason logout_in_bytes logout_out_bytes deleted_count expunged_count hdr_count body_count marker _raw
